blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A global company like Czarnikow employs people in many countries, and every country has its own labour law. The differences can be big: working hours, notice periods, overtime, holidays, parental leave, collective bargaining and how to terminate a contract are all governed locally.

HR must stay on top of these rules. A mistake in one country can create legal, financial and reputational damage in all the others. That is why most multinationals work with local legal advisors, and why HR business partners need a basic legal literacy of their own.

Compliance is never only about avoiding fines. It is also about fairness and trust. When employees know that the company respects the law, they trust the company with the rest.

items.q: According to the text, how is labour law decided for a global company?
items.why: "every country has its own labour law… all governed locally" — não existe padrão único global.

items.q: Why can a mistake in one country be so serious?
options: It can create legal, financial and reputational damage in all the others
It forces the company to leave that country
It ends every local contract at once
items.why: "A mistake in one country can create legal, financial and reputational damage in all the others."

items.q: Why do most multinationals work with local legal advisors?
options: Because the law forbids using an in-house team
Because local advisors are cheaper than HR
Because the rules are governed locally and are hard to track
items.why: As regras variam por país e mudam localmente, por isso o apoio de advogados locais.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which statement?
options: HR partners benefit from basic legal literacy
Compliance is mainly about avoiding fines
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que "Compliance is never only about avoiding fines" — a multa é só uma parte.

items.q: The final paragraph suggests that respecting the law…
options: is optional if fines are small
strengthens the wider relationship with employees
only matters to the legal department
items.why: Inferência: "they trust the company with the rest" — o respeito à lei sustenta uma confiança mais ampla.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Charlotte preparando um treinamento para gestores. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Morning, everyone. Thanks for joining. Today I want to walk you through how labour law differs across the three countries where most of you manage people: the UK, Brazil and Germany.

The headline is simple: there is no single rulebook. What is perfectly legal in one jurisdiction can breach the law in another. Take notice periods. In the UK, a long-serving employee may be entitled to several weeks; in Brazil, the rules on notice and severance are quite different again. So please, do not assume that a process that works in London will transfer to São Paulo.

Germany is the one that catches people out. Before any major restructuring, the company is required to consult the works council. That is not a courtesy — it is a legal obligation, and skipping it can stop a whole project.

My one ask is this: if you are planning anything that touches termination, overtime or parental leave, come to HR first. A quick call before you act saves us from a very expensive mistake later.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Which three countries does Charlotte focus on?
options: The UK, the US and France
items.why: "the UK, Brazil and Germany… where most of you manage people."

items.q: What is Charlotte's main point about the rules?
items.why: "The headline is simple: there is no single rulebook."

items.q: What must the company do in Germany before a major restructuring?
items.why: "the company is required to consult the works council… it is a legal obligation."

items.q: Why does Charlotte warn against assuming "a process that works in London will transfer to São Paulo"?
options: Because notice periods no longer exist in Brazil
Because the same steps may break the law in a different jurisdiction
items.why: Inferência: o que é legal numa jurisdição pode violar a lei em outra.

items.q: What does Charlotte imply by asking managers to "come to HR first"?
options: HR will handle the restructuring instead of managers
HR wants to control every small decision
Managers are not allowed to speak to employees
A short check beforehand prevents a costly legal error
items.why: Inferência: "A quick call before you act saves us from a very expensive mistake later."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Each country is a separate jurisdiction with its own rules." A jurisdiction is…
options: a legal territory where a set of laws applies
items.why: Jurisdiction = jurisdição: o território onde vale determinado conjunto de leis.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "In Germany, the firm must consult the ___ before a major restructuring."
items.why: Works council = comissão de trabalhadores, consultada antes de mudanças relevantes.

items.q: Choose the correct term: "After ten years of service, her ___ was three months of pay."
items.why: Severance = rescisão / verba rescisória paga ao encerrar o contrato.

items.q: "Every employer here has to comply with local overtime limits." To comply with means to…
items.why: Comply with = cumprir, obedecer a uma regra ou norma.

items.q: "Staff took extended parental leave after the baby arrived." This refers to…
options: time off to care for a new child
items.why: Parental leave = licença parental, período de afastamento para cuidar de um filho.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs que aparecem em reuniões sobre compliance. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "HR has to stay on top of changes in local labour law." To stay on top of means to…
options: keep fully aware of and in control of
items.why: Stay on top of = manter-se atualizado e no controle de algo.

items.q: "Legal advised us to hold off on the redundancies until the council was consulted." To hold off on means to…
items.why: Hold off on = adiar, segurar algo por enquanto.

items.q: "The union pushed back on the new overtime policy." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar de uma proposta.

items.q: "Before we act, we should run this by the local advisor." To run something by someone means to…
options: check it with them for their opinion
items.why: Run something by someone = submeter algo a alguém para avaliação ou aval.

items.q: "One compliance slip could land us in serious legal trouble." To land someone in trouble means to…
options: cause them to end up in a bad situation
items.why: Land someone in trouble = colocar alguém numa enrascada / situação ruim.
